prompt: I put together a first draft of a new module for receiving GitHub webhook deliveries — modules/webhooks/routes.ts, service.ts, repository.ts, plus a small adapter at adapters/webhooks/hmac-verifier.ts (all attached below). Before I wire it into modules/index.ts and open a PR, can you review it and point out anything that's off?

assertions.name: flags-routes-bypassing-service-to-repository
assertions.text: The review flags that routes.ts imports repository.ts directly and re-implements the delivery-dedupe check, instead of routing that logic through service.ts.

assertions.name: flags-service-importing-db-directly
assertions.text: The review flags that service.ts imports db/schema directly for the workspace lookup instead of adding a typed method to repository.ts.

assertions.name: flags-service-wiring-concrete-adapter-directly
assertions.text: The review flags that service.ts imports and instantiates the concrete HmacWebhookVerifier itself instead of resolving it through platform/container.ts.
